description.en: Import Jira tickets using custom JQL; create missing status columns automatically.
description.zh-TW: 使用自訂 JQL 匯入 Jira 工作項目，自動建立缺少的狀態欄位。

description.en: Choose Cloud for Jira Cloud REST v3, or Data Center for Jira Data Center REST v2.
description.zh-TW: Jira Cloud 使用 REST v3；Jira Data Center 使用 REST v2。請選擇你的 Jira 類型。

description.en: HTTPS API base URL, without /rest/api. Cloud: https://api.atlassian.com/ex/jira/<cloudId>. Data Center: https://jira.example.com, including any context path. Access requires host approval. Bearer credentials are sent only to the manifest domain, never to a custom host.
description.zh-TW: HTTPS API 基底網址，不含 /rest/api。Cloud 範例：https://api.atlassian.com/ex/jira/<cloudId>；Data Center 範例：https://jira.example.com，可包含站台路徑。連線需要核准主機；Bearer 憑證僅傳送至 manifest 宣告的網域，不會傳送至自訂主機。

description.en: HTTPS Jira site URL used for ticket links and stable identities, for example https://your-team.atlassian.net. Include any context path and keep this value stable between syncs.
description.zh-TW: 用於工作項目連結與識別的 HTTPS Jira 站台網址，例如 https://your-team.atlassian.net。請包含站台路徑，並在各次同步間維持相同網址。

label.zh-TW: Jira 網站網址（ticket 連結）

description.en: JQL query selecting tickets, for example project = APP AND fixVersion = "1.2.0". Missing Jira status columns are created automatically; duplicate matching column names fail the sync. Tickets that stop matching remain on the board.
description.zh-TW: 篩選 Jira 工作項目的 JQL，例如 project = APP AND fixVersion = "1.2.0"。缺少的狀態欄位會自動建立；同名欄位重複會導致同步失敗。不再符合查詢的卡片會保留在看板。

description.en: Customize imported card descriptions with {url}, {description}, {key}, and {summary}. Unknown placeholders remain literal. An empty template imports an empty description. Manual card edits are preserved by Cardbe on later syncs.
description.zh-TW: 使用 {url}、{description}、{key}、{summary} 自訂匯入的卡片描述。未知的佔位符會保留原文；空白模板會匯入空白描述。Cardbe 會保留卡片上的手動修改。

description.en: Cloud requires an OAuth access token; Data Center requires a personal access token. Email plus API token (Basic auth) is unsupported. Cardbe sends Bearer credentials only to the sole manifest domain when it is the only approved host; custom hosts do not receive credentials.
description.zh-TW: Cloud 使用 OAuth 存取權杖；Data Center 使用個人存取權杖。不支援電子郵件搭配 API token 的 Basic 驗證。只有 manifest 唯一宣告的網域也是唯一核准主機時，Cardbe 才會傳送 Bearer 憑證；自訂主機不會收到憑證。

label.en: Bearer token (OAuth access token or Data Center PAT)
label.zh-TW: Bearer token（OAuth access token 或 Data Center PAT）
